name: Hourglass
author: ReidenXerx
description: Screen time for your laptop, the way a phone shows it: today and this week at the laptop, by hour, by category and by app, how often you came back to it, and daily limits that nudge rather than lock. Counts only while you are at the keyboard. If you turn details on, it also says what you did in each app, as short labels such as YouTube, a project in your editor or what runs in a terminal; never raw window titles, never private windows. Nothing leaves the laptop.

barWidget.description: Screen time: today and this week by app and category, pick-ups and daily limits

schema.label: Daily limits
schema.description: Set them in the panel. Kept here as app:<class>=<minutes> or cat:<category>=<minutes>, separated by semicolons.

schema.label: Summary on Sunday evening
schema.description: A notification after 20:00 on Sunday with the week's total and how it compares with the week before.

schema.label: Stop counting after (seconds without input)
schema.description: How long without a key or the pointer before time stops counting. A film that keeps the screen awake still counts.

schema.label: Remember what you did in each app
schema.description: Short labels per app: the site in a browser, the project in an editor, what runs in a terminal. Never a window's title; never private windows or password managers. Off until you turn it on.

schema.label: Keep pages for these sites
schema.description: Sites, comma separated, whose page (a video, a repository) is kept as well as their name, for example YouTube, GitHub. Set them in the panel.

schema.label: Never describe these apps
schema.description: App classes, comma separated, whose details are never kept. Their time still counts.
